kind: adversarial impersonation test (agent), evidence for the human review of managed rule 11

foundBeforeFix.finding: impersonation marker survived logout and session revocation; the next user signing in on that browser could call /impersonation/stop and become the administrator
an impersonating administrator could mint a personal API token for the target that outlives the session
profile changes and session revocations while impersonating were attributed to the target only
superseded user_sessions rows stayed listed as live

fix: commit 41bb4fd: marker bound to {adminId,targetId} and honored only for the target; cleared on every sign-out path; disabled administrators do not regain a session; session rows closed on start and stop; self-service activity records the administrator; token minting refused while impersonating
notFixed: user invitations sent while impersonating do not record the administrator (code reading only)
impersonation has no time limit beyond the normal session

independentBlackBox.tester: separate automated agent, black-box, without access to the earlier tests
independentBlackBox.method: running reference app (development mode, cookie sessions, own database), curl with cookie jars and headless Chromium; administrators created through signup plus adula:install

results.sharedBrowserTakeover: secure: stop 401/422, admin area 403, replayed pre-logout cookie 401
results.forgedCookies: secure: tampered data or session cookie 401
results.whileImpersonating: secure: /admin 403, nested impersonation 403, token mint 403 E_IMPERSONATING, invite 403, CSRF-less 403
results.targetRules: secure: self 422, administrator 403, disabled 422, administrator disabled mid-impersonation 403 E_IMPERSONATOR_REVOKED
results.audit: every start, stop, profile and password action identifies the real administrator
results.ui: banner and stop control only in the impersonating session

residualRisks: the display name can be changed while impersonating (audited)
replay defence relies on server-side session tracking on every authenticated route
independentBlackBox.verdict: fix effective; the human review of managed rule 11 is still required
